Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid

Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company each d/b/a National Grid (the “Company”), attached is the Company’s reconciliation filing of administrative costs associated with Basic Service for the twelve month period ending December 31, 2022 and the proposed Basic Service Administrative Cost Factors effective May 1, 2023. Also attached are appearance of counsel, witness affidavit and Excel files. By Maebh Purcell. DPU 23-21.
